reason: Original v1 source domain included action a, while allowing different chosen actions per arm but limiting all held source actions to 6144. Different arms can require distinct action-indexed Bernoulli samples at the same timestep; <=6144 unique held samples is therefore not guaranteed and may require up to 12288. Resolve prospectively without consuming protected or synthetic held outcomes.

replacement_exogenous_source.source_unit: one shared exogenous uniform per (seed,t,c) independently of action, graph and theta; record once per world/timestep, common to candidate and every control, no alternate-action sampled y evaluated
replacement_exogenous_source.causal_intervention: each arm selects a before observation; evaluator computes y only for that arm's selected a from the common exogenous u; sampled unchosen y is neither computed nor leaked
replacement_exogenous_source.held_coin_count: 24 worlds *256 =6144 unique exogenous draws, reused across all arms and A-only sham; observations=6144 per arm
replacement_exogenous_source.fit_coin_count: 12 worlds *256 =3072 unique exogenous draws, reused across FIT-selection arms
replacement_exogenous_source.note: Shared exogenous noise yields paired outcomes and correlated arm evidence. Score expected regret on the fixed q and report realized utility separately. Do not mistake action/arm observation count for unique source first uses.

fit_worlds.selection_metric: mean expected net utility regret on second B t192..255 aggregated across 12 FIT worlds, no held information; deterministic tie break ascending hazard then ascending bonus
fit_worlds.controls: Context-bandit 16-cell with frozen 1/4 exploration, greedy 16-cell lookup, always-a0 passive, source-independent deterministic random, no-memory fixed policy. Oracle is evaluator-only, never an observational arm.

held_worlds.B: FORK theta0 or theta1 according to frozen cohort for t 64..127,192..255
held_worlds.sham: A-only chain theta0 for t 0..255, with the same per-world exogenous uniforms and separate model state
held_worlds.primary_metric: expected net utility regret on B_second t192..255, before actual consequence; exact retained thresholds H1-H4 and P0-P1 of v1

source_gate.mock_only_tests: witness injection permitted; must never compute u for any specified FIT or HELD seed
source_gate.preprimary: freeze this v2 source design and implementation, verify code+protocol SHA, test on mocked witness only; complete focused, dual OS full-final and archived real-source compatibility; separately authorized one-shot original synthetic FIT+HELD use only after that
